FLUIDLOVEBAND-BACKING_TRACK.title: Backing Track
FLUIDLOVEBAND-BACKING_TRACK.description: At the start of each combat, add a [gold]Rhythm[/gold] note to your Setlist.
FLUIDLOVEBAND-BACKING_TRACK.flavor: A laptop, a click, and a drummer who never asks for a cut of the door.
FLUIDLOVEBAND-CLICK_TRACK.title: Click Track
FLUIDLOVEBAND-CLICK_TRACK.description: At the start of each turn, if your Setlist is empty, add a [gold]Rhythm[/gold] note.
FLUIDLOVEBAND-SETLIST_PAPER.title: Setlist Paper
FLUIDLOVEBAND-SETLIST_PAPER.description: The first Song each combat is played twice.
FLUIDLOVEBAND-SETLIST_PAPER.flavor: Gaffer-taped to the stage floor. Mostly legible.
FLUIDLOVEBAND-GAFFER_TAPE.title: Gaffer Tape
FLUIDLOVEBAND-PLECTRUM.title: Plectrum
FLUIDLOVEBAND-PLECTRUM.flavor: Alex has lost forty of these.
FLUIDLOVEBAND-THE_RIDER.title: The Rider
FLUIDLOVEBAND-THE_RIDER.flavor: Two crates of cider and a bowl of green M&Ms.
FLUIDLOVEBAND-OL_MACS_BANJO.title: Ol' Mac's Banjo
FLUIDLOVEBAND-OL_MACS_BANJO.description: Gain 1 Energy at the start of each turn. Your [gold]Jams[/gold] do nothing.
